name: user-voice
description: Ties building to what real users said. On a feature request it finds matching quotes in your notes folder (simple keyword search, no model) and hands them to Claude; on a rough request Claude proposes 2-3 concrete options first and lets you pick in one question. A quiet band says when no user note mentions it. /user-voice shows the matches.

evidenceDir.title: Notes folder
evidenceDir.description: Folder of user notes (.md and .txt) to search. Relative paths are inside the project; ~ is your home folder. If it does not exist, no evidence is added.

maxQuotes.title: Quotes per request
maxQuotes.description: The most user quotes handed to Claude for one request.

proposeFirst.title: Propose before building
proposeFirst.description: On a rough feature request, Claude first proposes 2-3 concrete options with a recommendation and asks you to pick, instead of building the literal words.
